title: Exploring Selective Layer Fine-Tuning in Federated Learning

contributions.purpose: 刻画联邦学习中"客户端各自选择部分层微调"这一实际场景下层选择对全局模型收敛的影响
contributions.mechanism: 对允许客户端间/训练轮次间任意变化的层选择方案做理论收敛分析,推导收敛受两个关键因素影响:所选层的重要性、以及客户端间异质选择
contributions.evaluation: 定性/理论结果:收敛误差可分解为 E_t1+E_t2 两项,同时最小化二者可能产生矛盾的选择决策,且最优解不可得(ground-truth 不可求)
contributions.domain: 联邦学习 / 基础模型微调理论
contributions.source_quote: We theoretically analyze such a training scheme and investigate the impact of layer selection. The analytical results show that the selected layers affect the convergence performance with two critical aspects, namely the importance of layers and heterogeneous choices across clients.

contributions.purpose: 在客户端资源有限且各异的约束下,给出可操作的层选择方法
contributions.mechanism: 把选择性层微调形式化为优化问题,受其解启发提出利用本地梯度、并跨客户端调控层选择的策略性层选择方法
contributions.evaluation: 定性/算法(Algorithm 1);利用 relative gradient norm 类信号自适应选层,计算/通信成本远低于全模型微调(仅约 3.4% 计算成本)
contributions.domain: 联邦学习 / 参数高效微调
contributions.source_quote: Building on the theoretical analysis, we formulate the optimization problem of selective layer fine-tuning considering the limited and diverse resource budgets of clients. Inspired by the solution to this optimization problem, we propose an effective strategy for selecting layers for fine-tuning that are well-suited for the local data and available resources at clients.

contributions.purpose: 实证验证所提层选择策略优于多种基线
contributions.mechanism: 在图像与文本数据集上对比 Top/Bottom/Both/SNR/RGN 及 Full 微调基线,分同质资源与异质资源两种场景,并可视化各数据集所选层
contributions.evaluation: CIFAR-10/DomainNet(CLIP)、XGLUE-NC(XLM-Roberta)、五个 QA(LLaMA-2-7B)测试准确率(Table 1/2);异质资源下一致优于所有基线;单层微调 CLIP 即可媲美全模型微调
contributions.domain: 联邦学习 (图像分类/文本分类/QA)
contributions.source_quote: We conduct experiments to compare the proposed layer selection strategy with baseline methods on both image and text datasets. Experimental results demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed strategy in achieving better model performance, highlighting that the proposed strategy can find critical layers for fine-tuning while considering the client heterogeneity and training dynamics in FL.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Recent studies have extended the selective fine-tuning techniques to FL scenarios (Nguyen et al., 2022a; Chen et al., 2022; Hilmkil et al., 2021; Zhang et al., 2022b). Specifically, researchers (Lee et al., 2023; Dun et al., 2022) investigate layer-wise network decomposition to achieve selective model fine-tuning on clients. However, these works fail to offer methodologies for adaptive and dynamic layer selection ... Different from previous studies, we focus on providing an in-depth understanding of selective layer fine-tuning in FL
updating layers with higher relative gradient norms is more beneficial than other strategies, which is consistent with previous study (Lee et al., 2022).

notes: 理论+方法+实证三元结构。作者主动标注多处 trade-off/平局/comparable 结果:(1) 理论上同时最小化 E_t1、E_t2 两项可能产生矛盾选择,且最优解不可得;(2) 文本数据集(XGLUE-NC/QA)上所提方法与 RGN 基线表现相近(similar performance),仅共同超过 Top/Both 等,作者归因于二者选出的层相似;(3) 单层微调 CLIP 与全模型微调 comparable(因 CLIP 特征已足够强)。定位为对已有 FL 选择性微调工作(缺乏自适应/动态选择)的补足。整体报告优于固定策略基线,但对 RGN 属并列而非碾压。
